escenas.texto: Over five hundred and five million views. Thirty videos. And this week in Europe, one video didn't just win, it left everyone else far behind. How far? You'll see. This is Top 10 Social Media, the Europe edition. Three countdowns: the most viewed, the most commented and the most liked videos of the week. Real numbers, from ten to one, and the top of each podium stays hidden until its moment. Let's go.

The rules, quick and clear. Only videos posted in the last seven days that trended in Europe. One video per creator on each list. Music and news have their own space. Every number comes from the official YouTube API, measured at this week's cut-off. No guesses. Just data.

Countdown number one: the ten most viewed. And in Europe, the entry ticket is ten million. Number ten, from Poland, Polina, with “DIY spooky foggy mirror, creepy Halloween room decor”. Seventeen seconds, over ten million views.

Number nine, from the United Kingdom, Mrwhosetheboss, twenty-three million subscribers, with “6 ways iPhone Duo beats Samsung”. Over ten million views, and over six thousand two hundred comments. Hold on to that comment count.
At number eight, from the Netherlands, Ayse Acun, with a seven second hairstyle tutorial: the claw clip, half up, half down. Over ten million views.
Number seven, from Germany, Peakzmotivation, with “This Nerf Dart Just REFUSES To Fall...”. Fifty-eight seconds, over ten million views and over one hundred and eighty-five thousand likes.
At number six, from Spain, YoSoyDander. A nineteen second Short with over fourteen million views, and only eighty-one comments. Watched by millions, discussed by almost nobody.

Number five, from Germany, Dhruv Rathee, a channel with thirty-three point three million subscribers, with “How Indian Media BRAINWASHES You!”. A twenty minute video, over fourteen million views. The longest video in this top ten. Remember this name.
At number four, from Turkey, Food Therapy, with “How to Dice an Onion Like a Pro”. Over fourteen million views, from a channel of about forty-two thousand subscribers. And now, the podium.

Bronze medal, from the United Kingdom, Events Untold, with “Why Giant Pandas Spend Twelve Hours Eating”. An eight second Short, over sixteen million views, from a channel of about fifty-five thousand subscribers.

Silver medal, Deiva Divine, with “Can Corn Really Make Beautiful Flowers?!”. Over twenty-five million views, from a channel of about one hundred and forty thousand subscribers. A huge number. And still, not even close to number one.

Here it is. Number one most viewed in Europe: from Cyprus, Crafter Duck GARAGE, with “Making a Gold Prosthesis From Coins!”. Over eighty-two million views. Eighty-two million. More than three times the silver medal, and the biggest number of this whole edition, from a channel of about six hundred and nine thousand subscribers.

Now we change the scoreboard. Countdown number two: the ten most commented. Here, long videos take over. Number ten, from Poland, Vandiril, with “League Bans are getting SCARY...”. Over three thousand seven hundred comments.
Number nine, from the United Kingdom, The Critical Gamer, with “BioWare - Another Domino Falls”. Over three thousand eight hundred comments, on a five minute video.
At number eight, a familiar name: Crafter Duck GARAGE, with the gold prosthesis. Over three thousand nine hundred comments.
Number seven, Jazzghost, a channel with twenty-five point one million subscribers. A forty-two minute video with over four thousand one hundred comments.
At number six, from Turkey, Bakirkertenkele31. A thirty-eight minute video, over four thousand six hundred comments, and over one million views.
Number five, from the United Kingdom, BULKHEAD, with “The Hotzone, Episode One: The Wipe”. Seventy minutes long, and over four thousand seven hundred comments.
At number four, from Ukraine, Domer Grief, a channel with eight point seven million subscribers. A twenty-three minute video, over four thousand nine hundred comments.
Bronze medal in comments, from the United Kingdom, Mrwhosetheboss, with the iPhone Duo versus Samsung. Over six thousand two hundred comments. I told you to remember it.

Silver medal, from Turkey, Vural Üzül, with a forty-nine minute video. Over fourteen thousand comments, on just over two hundred and eighteen thousand views. That's more than six comments for every hundred views. The most talkative audience in this countdown. But number one?

Number one most commented in Europe: from Germany, Dhruv Rathee, with “How Indian Media BRAINWASHES You!”. Over twenty-four thousand comments. Twenty-four thousand. Fifth in views, and first in conversation, by a wide margin.

And the final countdown: the ten most liked. Number ten, from Poland, Things Opened, with “How a USB-C Cable Really Works”. Over one hundred and sixty-six thousand likes, from a channel of about eleven thousand subscribers.
Number nine, Kayla Ryan, with an eleven second Short. Over one hundred and seventy thousand likes.
At number eight, from Germany, Peakzmotivation, with the Nerf dart. Over one hundred and eighty-five thousand likes.
Number seven, from Turkey, Food Therapy, with the onion. Over two hundred and eighteen thousand likes.
At number six, from the United Kingdom, Helen Christie, with “Flappers did WHAT!?”. Over two hundred and forty-eight thousand likes, in twenty-three seconds.
Number five, from the United Kingdom, Events Untold, with the giant pandas. Over two hundred and ninety-one thousand likes.
At number four, from Spain, Jajamaru, with a twenty-seven second Short. Over three hundred and ten thousand likes. And now, the last podium of the night.
Bronze medal in likes, from the United Kingdom, Mrwhosetheboss. Over three hundred and thirty-two thousand likes. Present on all three lists tonight.
Silver medal, from Germany, Dhruv Rathee. Over four hundred and seventy-six thousand likes. Champion of comments, silver in likes. So who could be above?

Number one most liked in Europe: from Cyprus, Crafter Duck GARAGE, with “Making a Gold Prosthesis From Coins!”. Over one million likes. One million. More than double the silver medal. Number one in views, number one in likes. The undisputed king of Europe this week.

And the world tour isn't over. Next stop: the Americas. The link is in the description and in the playlist. Now it's your turn: which video should have made this countdown? Tell us in the comments with the hashtag Top10RS. Links to every original video are in the description: go support the creators. Subscribe and hit the bell. A new Top 10 every Sunday.
